title: University Medal
description: La Medaglia dell'Università della Svizzera italiana è conferita in segno di riconoscenza a persone che si siano distinte per "l'importante contributo allo sviluppo dell'USI". È attribuita dal Consiglio dell'Università e viene consegnata durante il Dies academicus.

blocks.html: The Università della Svizzera italiana Medal is awarded as a mark of recognition to those who have distinguished themselves for "their important contribution to the development of USI". It is conferred by the University Council, and is bestowed during the Dies academicus.

blocks.name: Pietro Balestra
blocks.html:
For his role as the first Dean of the Faculty of Economics and for his vital contribution to the University's growth.

Conferred on 25 April 2026 during the 30th Dies academicus.

• The Medal

    The Medal features a unique design that is an artistic interpretation of the university's logo, a variation featuring different layers: this harmonious movement from different directions supports the letters "USI". The Medal thus represents the energy that surrounds the university, unleashed by the region and the people who support it and - in different ways - contribute to its development. It was created by goldsmith Maros from Lugano. Each medal is a unique piece, handmade in solid silver, and created using the lost-wax casting technique and sculptural ornamentation.
